hypothesis_original: NeuroAI can supply testable mechanisms, but biological analogy should only enter MeshyAnts when converted into a falsifiable software experiment.
hypothesis_revised: This cycle, NeuroAI supplied experiment-design constraints and rejected translations, not a new coordination primitive. A labeled queue, router, DAG, manager, or Brooks subsumption stack already expresses the v2 software priors. The only leftover empirical question is whether modular+sparse MeshyAnts beats those simpler systems on a heterogeneous failure-prone mix (Experiment A). Biology still must not enter without a prediction that can fail.
falsification_of_watch: The watch treats a podcast as evidence, or promotes a v2 prior to a NeuroAI mechanism without a leftover test vs queue/router/DAG/manager/subsumption.
round_1_finding: Scheduler critic rejected leftover novelty (score 0). Accepted.

leftover_empirical_questions.title: Does modular+sparse MeshyAnts beat competent simpler systems on the hypothesized win regime?
leftover_empirical_questions.not_a_new_primitive: Local neighborhoods and sparse bridges are already in ARCHITECTURE.md. S3 analogizes BANC to subsumption, which is a baseline, not a MeshyAnts feature.
leftover_empirical_questions.software_comparison: MeshyAnts local-claim + decaying field + sparse INSIGHT/DANGER/SATURATION versus (i) capability-labeled priority queue, (ii) central load-aware router, (iii) deterministic DAG, (iv) manager-worker, (v) Brooks inhibit hierarchy.
leftover_empirical_questions.measurable_prediction: On a heterogeneous failure-prone mix, MeshyAnts reduces recovery time or duplicate-claim rate versus all five simpler systems at matched quality and equal budget. On a sequential DAG it loses or ties the orchestrator on quality and wall time.
leftover_empirical_questions.falsification: Any of the five simpler systems matches or beats MeshyAnts on quality and coordination cost in the heterogeneous regime. Flat blackboard-only is not an adequate baseline.
leftover_empirical_questions.why_analogy_may_fail: BANC modules are embodied body-part circuits. Software neighborhoods are invented labels. S6 says extra agents often hurt once a single worker is capable.

experiment_design_constraints.title: Include a predicted lose regime and a recorded single-worker baseline
experiment_design_constraints.constraint: MESH-101 must include a sequential DAG regime expected to favor manager/DAG, a heterogeneous maybe-win regime, and a single-worker baseline. If that baseline is already strong, predict MeshyAnts loss.
experiment_design_constraints.measurable_prediction: The published Experiment A spec names both regimes and logs single-worker success before any multi-agent run.
experiment_design_constraints.leftover_vs_scheduler: This is a contract constraint, not a runtime primitive. It prevents a handicapped baseline.
experiment_design_constraints.falsification: Experiment A reports only a flat-blackboard comparison or omits the single-worker number.

experiment_design_constraints.title: Subsumption / inhibit hierarchy is a required baseline
experiment_design_constraints.constraint: Bates et al. analogize BANC to Brooks-style distributed/subsumption control. MESH-103 must include that baseline, not only a flat queue.
experiment_design_constraints.measurable_prediction: MESH-103 lists a subsumption-like inhibit hierarchy as a first-class baseline with the same tasks/models/tools/budget.
experiment_design_constraints.leftover_vs_scheduler: Adds a baseline the scheduler critic already wanted. Does not add a MeshyAnts feature.
experiment_design_constraints.falsification: Phase A ships without a subsumption/inhibit baseline.

experiment_design_constraints.title: Defer selection; no LLM-as-fitness in the core experiment
experiment_design_constraints.constraint: No Queen / phenotype mutation until Phase A–C exist. Future fitness is a vector (quality, verification confidence, cost, latency, reliability), never tasks/hour. No LLM evolutionary operator in the core experiment.
experiment_design_constraints.measurable_prediction: MESH-104/105 configs have selection_enabled=false. If someone later enables single-proxy selection early, verified quality is predicted to drop while throughput rises.
experiment_design_constraints.leftover_vs_scheduler: A don't. The simpler system is no-selection.
experiment_design_constraints.falsification: Core Experiment A/B runs Queen or an LLM judge as fitness.

experiment_design_constraints.title: Do not put task assignment in a rich-club / hub Queen
experiment_design_constraints.constraint: Fly rich club is ~30% of neurons; integrator/broadcaster 5× labels are arbitrary; Podschun et al. fit a highway, not a controller. Assignment stays local-claim.
experiment_design_constraints.measurable_prediction: No MESH-105 topology named rich-club-controller is treated as a MeshyAnts candidate. Hub-assign, if run, is scored as a manager baseline.
experiment_design_constraints.leftover_vs_scheduler: Rejects a tempting translation. Prevents a hidden manager.
experiment_design_constraints.falsification: A rich-club-controller topology is implemented as the MeshyAnts condition.

software_priors_neuroai_not_warrant.title: Bounded verify/repair
software_priors_neuroai_not_warrant.already_expressed_by: deterministic DAG with a check step; manager-worker with retry bound
software_priors_neuroai_not_warrant.why_not_adopted_as_neuroai: Fly reciprocity is millisecond E-I feedback. The leftover test (terminal checker vs bounded recurrence) does not isolate biology.

software_priors_neuroai_not_warrant.title: Join + fan-out traffic
software_priors_neuroai_not_warrant.already_expressed_by: DAG reduce node; pub/sub topic; global result log
software_priors_neuroai_not_warrant.why_not_adopted_as_neuroai: Degree-imbalance labels are arbitrary. If a join node assigns work it is a manager.

software_priors_neuroai_not_warrant.title: Versioned composable skills
software_priors_neuroai_not_warrant.already_expressed_by: ARCHITECTURE.md phenotype; prompt assembly that omits unused skills
software_priors_neuroai_not_warrant.why_not_adopted_as_neuroai: S4 is two-monkey PFC geometry, not a multi-agent org chart.

software_priors_neuroai_not_warrant.title: Exploration / value-of-learning budget
software_priors_neuroai_not_warrant.already_expressed_by: central contextual bandit; ε-greedy; priority boost on uncertain high-payoff work
software_priors_neuroai_not_warrant.why_not_adopted_as_neuroai: Human deliberation time is not replica count. The watch's own falsifier was a central bandit.
